name: gsql
description: TigerGraph GSQL support: syntax highlighting, diagnostics, completion, hover, navigation and formatting through gsql-lsp.

gsql.server.path.description: Path to the gsql-lsp executable; a leading ~ and ${workspaceFolder} are expanded. The default uses the server bundled with the extension, or gsql-lsp from PATH.

gsql.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.

gsql.diagnostics.unknownTypes.description: Warn about vertex and edge types that are not declared in the workspace (only when the workspace declares a schema).

gsql.diagnostics.unknownAttributes.description: Warn about attributes that the vertex or edge type does not declare.

gsql.diagnostics.undefinedNames.description: Warn about identifiers in queries that are not defined.

gsql.diagnostics.unused.description: Fade out accumulators and variables that are never used.

gsql.diagnostics.languageRules.description: Check rules from the GSQL language reference: reserved words used as names, where accumulators may be assigned or modified, virtual edge and accumulator type restrictions, interpreted and distributed query limitations, and exact comparison of FLOAT/DOUBLE values.

gsql.diagnostics.noSchemaNotice.description: Say so (a warning, once per file, on the first query name that uses a type) when no schema is found, because types and attributes are then not checked.

gsql.diagnostics.duplicateDefinitions.description: Report a CREATE that repeats a vertex, edge, graph or query name an earlier CREATE defines (in the same file or another one).

gsql.diagnostics.style.description: Hint at deviations from the GSQL Style Guide, with a quick fix: keywords and reserved words that are not in all caps, and `#` comments (use `//`).

gsql.diagnostics.floatEquality.description: Warn about exact equality between FLOAT/DOUBLE values (comparisons with whole numbers, such as `x == 0`, and `x == float_to_int(x)` are not reported).

gsql.format.keywordCase.description: Keyword case applied by the formatter.

gsql.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inferred alias types and query argument names.

gsql.semanticTokens.lexical.description: Also send semantic tokens for keywords, literals and comments (normally highlighted by the TextMate grammar).
